units_note: 所有价格换算为 €/MWh 存储；1 €/MWh = 0.1 ct/kWh。

fx.source: ECB euro reference rates (via Banca d'Italia)

wholesale.what: 电力交易所「日前市场」的平均成交价，好比菜市场的进货价，每天都在变。

items.note: 瑞典分 4 个价区，这里是全国口径；北部水电多，价格更低。
土耳其日前市场价格（PTF），原文以美元计。
EIA 跟踪的 11 个交易中心平均，是预测值；各地差很多，例如 PJM 2026 年负荷加权均价 75.03 $/MWh。

items.period: 广东 2026年4月 月度合约均价
items.note: 中国没有全国统一批发价，这里用广东作参考；各省差别大。

household.what: 家里电费单上一度电的价格，含电网费和税，好比超市零售价。

items.note: 欧洲 38 国里最便宜；政府对用电量较低的家庭有补贴。
居民电价由政府定价，不跟随现货价格波动。

industrial.what: 工厂和企业用电的价格，影响制造业成本。不同来源口径不同（有的含税、有的不含），看大小关系即可。

items.note: 含全部税费，按年用电 100 万度的企业计算。
含税，按年用电 100 万度的企业计算。
年用电 500–2000 MWh 的企业，不含增值税；Eurostat 只给到两位小数。
含税，按年用电 100 万度的企业计算。
年用电 500–2000 MWh 的企业，不含增值税。
按今天汇率换算；里拉贬值时，欧元价格会显得更低。
企业电价；各省、各电压等级差别很大。

auction.what: 陆上风电场能卖电的“保障价”：政府招标中标价，或与企业签的长期购电合同（PPA）价。

items.note: EEG 陆上风电招标，比上一轮 5.06 ct 又降了。
此前几期约 86–87 €/MWh，这一期因竞争和改造（repowering）项目多而明显下降。
近期没有找到可比的陆上风电招标结果；西班牙项目主要靠企业购电合同（PPA）。
近几轮陆上风电拍卖中标项目很少，价格不具代表性。
瑞典没有政府风电招标，项目靠市场电价和企业购电合同（PPA）。
报价都在底价，竞争转向额外缴纳的贡献费。
北美风电 PPA 报价的低位（第 25 百分位）。

title.zh: 中国2027批次风电机制电价多数上涨

sentences.en: By 11 November, seven provinces had published wind results for the 2027 batch of China's mechanism-price auctions, according to an industry tally.
sentences.zh: 据行业统计，截至11月11日，已有7个省份公布2027批次风电机制电价竞价结果。

sentences.en: Gansu cleared at 0.244 yuan/kWh (up 24.9%) and Heilongjiang at 0.2845 (up 24.7%), while Jiangxi (0.377) and Guangxi (0.359) ended close to their caps.
Liaoning was the only decline (-9.1%) after the province cut its cap from 0.33 to 0.30 yuan/kWh.
sentences.zh: 辽宁是唯一下降的省份（-9.1%），原因是当地把上限从0.33元下调至0.30元。

insight.en: The article links the rise to few wind bidders in several provinces and to developers moving away from bidding at the floor; in some provinces, higher prices came with smaller protected volumes.
insight.zh: 文章认为，上涨原因是多个省份风电参与者少，以及开发商不再一味压到底价；但部分省份价格上涨的同时，可获保障的电量变小了。

oem.en: Higher mechanism prices can ease some price pressure on Chinese wind turbines, but smaller protected volumes mean more output must be sold at market prices.
oem.zh: 机制电价上涨可能缓解一部分风机压价压力，但保障电量缩小意味着更多电量要按市场价出售。

watch.en: When modelling Chinese projects, check both the mechanism price and the share of output it covers.
watch.zh: 测算中国项目收益时，既要看机制电价，也要看它覆盖多少比例的发电量。

watch.en: Follow the provinces that have started but not finished bidding, such as Hebei, Zhejiang and Shanxi.
watch.zh: 关注已启动但尚未出结果的省份，例如河北、浙江、山西。

news.source: Huxiu（转北极星太阳能光伏网）

title.en: German day-ahead power above €350/MWh on still days in November
title.zh: 德国日前电价11月无风日一度超过350欧元/兆瓦时

sentences.en: German day-ahead prices averaged €351.48/MWh on 10 November, compared with only €13.12/MWh on a windy day in October.
sentences.zh: 德国日前电价在11月10日日均达到351.48欧元/兆瓦时，而10月一个大风天仅为13.12欧元/兆瓦时。

sentences.en: Weekly averages eased from €256.59/MWh (2–8 Nov) to €197.66/MWh (16–22 Nov).
sentences.zh: 周均价从256.59欧元/兆瓦时（11月2–8日）回落至197.66欧元/兆瓦时（11月16–22日）。

sentences.en: The 2027 baseload future stood at about €146/MWh on 20 November, while 2028 traded about €44 lower.
sentences.zh: 11月20日，2027年基荷期货约为146欧元/兆瓦时，2028年合约低约44欧元。

insight.en: Gas plants set the price in many hours, so spot prices jump when wind is weak and collapse when wind is strong.
insight.zh: 很多时段由燃气电厂决定电价，所以风小时现货价格飙升，风大时价格暴跌。

oem.en: High prices in low-wind hours and very low prices in windy hours show why wind output timing matters for revenue, which raises interest in storage and hybrid projects.
oem.zh: 无风时高价、大风时极低价，说明风电的“发电时段”直接影响收入，这会提升市场对储能和风储混合项目的兴趣。

watch.en: Customers may ask more about capture prices and curtailment; prepare yield profiles by hour, not only annual totals.
watch.zh: 客户可能更关注“实际捕获电价”和弃风，要准备按小时的发电曲线，而不只是年发电量。

watch.en: The page names 7 December, when final grid fees are due, as the next date to watch.
watch.zh: 该页面提到12月7日公布最终电网费，可作为下一个关注日期。

title.en: Polish spot power hits highest level since December 2022
title.zh: 波兰现货电价升至2022年12月以来最高

sentences.en: Poland's day-ahead price averaged about 745 PLN/MWh in October, up about 12.5% on September and the highest since December 2022, according to Forum Energii.
sentences.zh: 据Forum Energii，波兰10月日前电价均价约745兹罗提/兆瓦时，环比上涨约12.5%，为2022年12月以来最高。

sentences.en: Gas on the Polish exchange averaged 409 PLN/MWh, up 18.7% month on month.
sentences.zh: 波兰交易所天然气均价为409兹罗提/兆瓦时，环比上涨18.7%。

sentences.en: The think tank links the rise to higher fuel costs from the Middle East conflict and limited gas availability.
sentences.zh: 该智库认为，上涨与中东冲突推高燃料成本以及天然气供应紧张有关。

insight.en: When gas is expensive, electricity from wind becomes more valuable in a coal- and gas-heavy system like Poland's.
insight.zh: 在波兰这样依赖煤电和气电的系统里，天然气一贵，风电发出的电就更值钱。

oem.en: Higher power prices can make Polish corporate PPAs for onshore wind more attractive, which may support turbine demand if permitting allows.
oem.zh: 电价走高可能让波兰陆上风电的企业购电合同（PPA）更有吸引力，如果审批跟得上，有望带动风机需求。

watch.en: Track whether Polish buyers sign more onshore wind PPAs in the coming months.
watch.zh: 跟踪未来几个月波兰买家是否签更多陆上风电PPA。

watch.en: Note that delivered prices were lower than spot (600 PLN/MWh) because many buyers had hedged with futures.
watch.zh: 注意实际交付电价（600兹罗提/兆瓦时）低于现货价，因为很多买家用期货做了对冲。

title.en: Fitch sees Turkish generation price rising to $60/MWh in 2027
title.zh: 惠誉预计土耳其2027年发电价格升至60美元/兆瓦时

sentences.en: Fitch expects Türkiye's electricity generation price to rise from about $50/MWh in 2026 to $60/MWh in 2027, a 20% increase.
sentences.zh: 惠誉预计土耳其发电价格将从2026年约50美元/兆瓦时升至2027年60美元/兆瓦时，涨幅20%。

sentences.en: The weighted average market clearing price (PTF) was $61.24/MWh in October 2026, up 5.2% on September.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月土耳其市场清算价（PTF）加权平均为61.24美元/兆瓦时，环比上涨5.2%。

sentences.en: The report gives no forecast for consumer tariffs.
sentences.zh: 该报告没有给出居民和企业终端电价的预测。

insight.en: A higher expected market price supports the merchant period that YEKA winners face before their fixed tariff starts.
insight.zh: 市场电价预期上升，有利于YEKA中标项目在固定电价生效前的市场化售电期收入。

oem.en: Better merchant revenue outlook can make Turkish developers more willing to move from award to turbine orders.
oem.zh: 市场化收入预期改善，可能让土耳其开发商更愿意从中标推进到风机下单。

watch.en: Price offers in TRY or USD carry currency risk; agree the currency and indexation clearly in contracts.
watch.zh: 以里拉或美元报价都有汇率风险，合同中要写清币种和调价机制。

watch.en: Track the monthly PTF average as a signal of how attractive the merchant period is for YEKA winners.
watch.zh: 跟踪每月PTF均价，作为判断YEKA中标项目市场化售电期收益的信号。

title.en: Türkiye lowers subsidised household power limit to 3,000 kWh for 2027
title.zh: 土耳其2027年把居民补贴电量上限降至3000千瓦时

sentences.en: Regulator EPDK set the 2027 limit for the supported household tariff at 3,000 kWh a year, down from 4,000 kWh in 2026 and 5,000 kWh in 2025.
sentences.zh: 监管机构EPDK将2027年居民补贴电价的年用电上限定为3000千瓦时，2026年为4000千瓦时，2025年为5000千瓦时。

sentences.en: About 6.5 million households, roughly 14.7% of residential subscribers, will move to a high-consumption tariff.
sentences.zh: 约650万户、约占居民用户14.7%的家庭将转为高用电量电价。

sentences.en: EPDK said it made no change to the national tariff itself.
sentences.zh: EPDK表示，全国电价本身没有调整。

insight.en: Türkiye is gradually shifting more households toward cost-reflective prices while keeping support for low users.
insight.zh: 土耳其正逐步让更多家庭支付更接近成本的电价，同时保留对低用电家庭的补贴。

oem.en: Less subsidy pressure on the state budget can support a more market-based power sector, which helps long-term investor confidence in Turkish wind.
oem.zh: 补贴压力减轻有助于电力行业更加市场化，从长期看有利于投资者对土耳其风电的信心。

watch.en: This affects households only; industrial and commercial limits stay at 15,000 kWh, so customer power costs are unchanged by this step.
watch.zh: 这次只影响居民；工业和商业用户的15000千瓦时上限不变，因此对企业客户电费没有直接影响。

watch.en: Watch for the next EPDK tariff decision, which could change retail prices.
watch.zh: 关注EPDK下一次电价调整决定，它可能改变终端电价。
